title: Submersion
summary: SUBMER'SION, noun [Latin submersus.] 1. The act of putting under water or causing to be overflowed; as the submersion of an isle or tract of land. 2. The act of plunging under water; the act of drowni

inlines.v: SUBMER'SION, noun [Latin submersus.] 1. The act of putting under water or causing to be overflowed; as the submersion of an isle or tract of land. 2. The act of plunging under water; the act of drowning.
